objective: Map #306 warning text to the pinned planner source and determine what the existing log can distinguish.

source_files.relevance: getInflateOccupancy: returns -1 outside map, 1 for unknown, otherwise inflated-mask value.
Terminal warning path: after a blocked control point, no later free control point is found.
Direction generation: A* path/control-law intersection search; warning when no usable intersection is recorded.
Potential index-boundary issue: Astar_id is changed and indexed before the next loop-bound check; runtime exercise is unknown.
First-three warning path: spline collision sample at t <= bspline_interval_ returns false; log prints t but no position.
Emergency-stop branch is triggered by an online trajectory collision check inside emergency_time_.

snapshot_cross_check.qualification: These path samples are compared against a snapshot taken before the spline start stamps; they do not establish occupancy at optimizer call time.

findings.detail: getInflateOccupancy returns 1 for unknown and -1 outside the map. Optimizer call sites store the integer in bool, so either condition is treated as occupied; current logs do not distinguish them.

The warning is emitted when a sampled spline point with t <= bspline_interval_ is occupied, then the rebound optimizer returns false. All 6,290 #306 instances logged t=0.000000. The position, voxel state, and source/fusion stamp were not logged, so unknown, out-of-map, and inflated occupancy remain indistinguishable.

After a control point is found occupied, the routine scans later control points for a free point; if none exists it sets STOP_FOR_ERROR and returns false. The warning does not record which point or why cells were blocked.

The routine has an obstacle segment and an A* path but fails to record a valid intersection between that path and a control-point normal; it still returns a rebound request. The warning is not a direct test of unknown occupancy.

In the A* path search loop, Astar_id is incremented or decremented and then used to index the vector before the next bounds check. If the search reaches either end without finding a sign crossing, this can index outside the vector. Existing logs do not prove this occurred or caused the warning count.

All four published spline first samples fall in known-free cells with zero inflation in snapshot #03. That snapshot predates the spline starts by about 0.91 s, so it does not resolve the t=0 warnings.

limitations: No planner attempt ID, collision sample coordinates, voxel indices, or map revision/source timestamp were logged for warning events.
Warning counts are repeated planner events, not unique collision sites or unique B-splines.
No trajectory server/controller/PX4 was present and no generated trajectory was executed.
The potential vector-index issue was found by source inspection only; no sanitizer or runtime reproduction was performed.
next_diagnostic: In an isolated overlay, log one structured record per optimizer attempt with plan/goal ID, collision point xyz and voxel index, in-map/unknown/raw/inflated classification, and current map epoch/map_id plus last fused-depth and occupancy-update stamps. Record terminal-search range and A* path bounds. Add a bounds guard in the diagnostic candidate and run a sanitizer-enabled comparison before attributing direction warnings.
